docs.title: CATKIN Black Chic Luxury Mascara
docs.subtitle:
What It Is:

A high-performance mascara designed to create fuller, longer, and beautifully defined lashes with an elegant black finish. The lightweight formula delivers dramatic eye-enhancing effects while maintaining a comfortable, smudge-resistant wear.

How It Works:

The precision brush coats each lash evenly from root to tip, helping lift, lengthen, and separate lashes without clumping. The waterproof and long-lasting formula keeps lashes looking fresh and curled throughout the day.

What's Special:

Fuller & Longer Lashes - Instantly enhances lash volume and length.

Waterproof & Smudge-Proof - Resists sweat, humidity, and daily wear.

Lightweight Formula - Comfortable on lashes without heaviness.

Smooth Application - Builds effortlessly without clumping or flaking.

Why You'll Love It:

Whether for natural everyday makeup or bold glam looks, this mascara delivers long-lasting curl, definition, and luxurious black intensity for effortlessly captivating eyes.

docs.subtitle:
INTO YOU Aqua Burst Lip Glaze (2.0)

Crystal Clear Shine. Glass-Like Lips.

Finish & Effect

Light-reflective, ultra-glossy shine that creates a plump, glass-lip look with a juicy, translucent glow.

Shades

AB04 Crushed Diamond Berry (HOT)

Cool-toned strawberry with blue shimmer, juicy and sparkling (Soobin's shade)

AB01 Fizzy Apricot (HOT)

A soft apricot nude with a radiant, translucent glow

AB03 Moonlight Persimmon (HOT)

A sweet, juicy persimmon tone with a hint of warmth

AB02 Water Peach

Designed to complement olive and neutral skin tones

AB05 Tea Mambo

A refined iced-tea shade with an effortless chic vibe

AB06 Amber Brown

A modern amber brown, perfect for deeper lips & skin tones

Hydrating Essence Formula

89% Essence Complex

Multi-dimensional lip care that helps:

soothe and hydrate

smooth the look of lip lines

keep lips soft and nourished

24H moisture comfort

Lightweight, non-greasy texture with a fresh, juicy feel

Shine & Color Technology

Crystal High-Refraction Tech

Creates a 3D high-shine "bouncy lip" effect

Buildable color payoff

sheer but visible in one swipe

enhanced pigment for deeper lips

💡 How to Choose

Q: 2.0 vs 1.0?

2.0: richer pigment, fuller glossy finish → best for deeper lips or bold shine

1.0: more sheer, natural MLBB effect → ideal for light lips

Q: Finish difference?

2.0: more saturated, plump glossy look

1.0: more transparent, watery shine

docs.title: Huile Prodigieuse® Or 50 ml
docs.subtitle:
Discover the iconic Huile Prodigieuse® cocktail of 7 precious 100% botanical origin oils in a golden Or version.

This shimmering dry oil with natural-origin golden pearly particles infuses all skin types and skin tones with an irresistible iridescent glow.

It gives a satin feel and illuminates the face, body and hair and moisturizes the skin in a single step. Your skin looks more beautiful, soft and silky, with no oily finish.

Its effectiveness is proven: it offers long-lasting hydration, leaves skin satiny smooth and luminous for 100% of users⁽¹⁾.

Its texture with an inimitable dry touch is available in a spray bottle. It releases an irresistible scent of sunshine and warm sand that will infuse your skin with radiant sensuality.

To create its Huile Prodigieuse®, NUXE selected 7 precious 100% botanical origin oils: Tsubaki, Argan, Macadamia, Borage, Camellia, Hazelnut, Sweet Almond.

⁽¹⁾Usage test - 20 volunteers. Satisfaction % immediately after the 1st application.
docs.pivota_insight_summary: Huile Prodigieuse® Or 50 ml is a brow product from Nuxe in 50ml, with source-backed cues around hydration.
